patel-pushback.subject: Re: Greenhouse quote — referral from Lori McG.
body: Thank you for the detailed write-up. I appreciate the honesty on the permit.
I have to be straight though — the number came in a bit above where I was. I showed it to my husband and we'd like to know if there's room to come down, or if we need to scale the footprint.
Open to a short call this week.

body: (Patel hasn't replied. Steph pinged her this morning — she said "thanks, we're thinking about it." That usually means no.)
The quote didn't mention the creek or the permit. She's probably running it by someone else who did.

patel-fast-reply.subject: Re: Greenhouse quote — referral from Lori McG.
body: Thank you for the thorough write-up. Honestly, the fact that you flagged the permit situation before we even talked numbers is why Lori sent me to you.
The price works. One question — if we end up on the hook for a wetland setback review, who handles the county side? You, me, or both?
Ready to move when you are.

Permit question — your answer sets expectations for the whole job
